Benchmark.title: Ansible string substitution
Benchmark.description: Tagged string values retain their literal contents.

Rule.title: Generate Ansible string variables
Rule.fix: - name: XCCDF Value pipe # promote to variable set_fact: pipe: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value folded # promote to variable set_fact: folded: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value quotes # promote to variable set_fact: quotes: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value backslash # promote to variable set_fact: backslash: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value comment # promote to variable set_fact: comment: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value mapping # promote to variable set_fact: mapping: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value spaces # promote to variable set_fact: spaces: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value multiline # promote to variable set_fact: multiline: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value tab # promote to variable set_fact: tab: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value cr # promote to variable set_fact: cr: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value bool # promote to variable set_fact: bool: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value number # promote to variable set_fact: number: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value unicode # promote to variable set_fact: unicode: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value linebreaks # promote to variable set_fact: linebreaks: !!str tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value already_quoted # promote to variable set_fact: already_quoted: "" tags: - always - name: XCCDF Value numeric # promote to variable set_fact: numeric: 42 tags: - always - name: Keep block scalars debug: msg: |- literal block tag_text: "example: !!str "
